task_config.name: wide_aiming_v1
task_config.action: q_default + xi_joint_offset + action_scale * a_exec; uniform soft clip

chest_posture.allowance: fixed commanded target-normal elevation; forward lean only
chest_posture.preference: upright remains preferred even for low targets
chest_posture.initial_pose: normal upright limit required before every episode

task_config.contact_command: measured support position error; zero during adjustment or commanded movement
task_config.target_coordinates: world-fixed, spherical range/azimuth/elevation from initial chest

observed_support.release: explicit target change or nonzero velocity command
observed_support.imagination: truncate before the unobserved capture transition
observed_support.command: anchor minus current feet, in the current base frame
